deposits.genre_observed: DOI registry (Crimson Hexagon / NH-OS DOI Registry v7.0, March 2026): version history, distribution tables, new-records list, auto-extracted précis index, open items
deposits.incidental: Recovered body does not match the deposit title: the title is the emoji work (zenodo.18512289) but the canonical bytes are the DOI Registry v7.0 (zenodo.19055255) blog post; the emoji work appears only as one row (lines 173, 177, 810, 1360). The précis index carries one-line auto-extracted summaries of other deposits' historical claims (e.g. Sappho 31 as origin point, line 962; Socratic vow as first Western articulation, line 1076; Revelation as template of Gospels, line 1242) but reports them rather than arguing them; they belong to the deposits they summarise.
